canonical_name: Producto interno bruto (PIB) total anual a precios corrientes en dólares
semantic_fingerprint: GDP level; annual; total economy; current prices; USD; national/regional aggregates
disambiguation_rules: Use for total GDP level in current USD.
Do not use for GDP per capita.
Do not use for real/volume GDP or growth rate.

canonical_name: Producto interno bruto (PIB) total anual por habitante a precios corrientes en dólares
unit: dólares por habitante a precios corrientes
semantic_fingerprint: GDP per capita; annual; current prices; USD; total economy
disambiguation_rules: Use only when the question asks per-capita GDP.
Current-price series can move because of both output/prices and exchange rates.

canonical_name: Producto interno bruto (PIB) anual por habitante por objeto del gasto a precios constantes en dólares
semantic_fingerprint: GDP per capita; annual; constant/volume prices; 2018 reference; USD; expenditure dimension
disambiguation_rules: Use for per-capita GDP at constant prices/volume.
The series has a reference year of 2018 and an expenditure dimension.

canonical_name: Producto interno bruto anual (PIB) por actividad económica a precios constantes en moneda nacional
unit: Country-specific national currency at reference prices
semantic_fingerprint: GDP level; annual; constant/volume prices; national currency; economic activity dimension
disambiguation_rules: Use when the requested output is constant-price GDP in national currency and the activity dimension is relevant.
Do not silently convert to USD or per capita.
